title: VoiceMemberMoveEvent
description: VOICE_MEMBER_MOVE bus event (discordy.guild.v1, routed by guild_id). A moderator moved a member to another voice channel or disconnected them (PATCH /guilds/{id}/members/{uid} with channel_id). The gateway applies it to the member's live voice session and never dispatches it to clients; it is ignored when the member is not in voice. Clients observe the result as VOICE_STATE_UPDATE plus, for a move, VOICE_SERVER_UPDATE with a token for the new channel.

channel_id.description: The voice channel to move the member to, or null to disconnect them.
